writeup: Woot has a new ASUS Prime A620A-PLUS WiFi AM5 ATX motherboard for $69.99, with only one left and a limit of one per customer. DirectDial sells the same board for $141, Newegg third-party sellers ask about $159, and Aztek Computers lists it at $161.43. It includes WiFi 6, an 8+2+1 power stage, and support for Ryzen 9000 CPUs, so it is a solid budget base for a new AM5 build.
